value.rationale: Degree-four elliptic normal curves with their three rational defining quadrics are a canonical arithmetic-geometric moduli problem. The first complete F2 projective atlas relates quadric splitting, point spectra and rational fourth-order osculation; the two N=4 equal-profile embeddings are separated by natural intrinsic embedded invariants. Completeness and the geometric distinction make this an informative nonroutine finite classification, without claiming a downstream theorem.
